Alongside castings the Company sells patterns and operates captive ground-mounted solar power capacity.

risks.note: Economic downturns or fluctuations can impact agricultural incomes and investment in machinery; changes in commodity prices and rural economic conditions can influence farmers' purchasing power and demand for tractors. Management explicitly links the Company's fortunes to farmers' income, particularly through minimum support prices (MSP).

The CFO resigned with effect from 12th May, 2025 and a successor was appointed only from 3rd October, 2025; the Company Secretary & Compliance Officer appointed with effect from 6th January, 2025 resigned with effect from 3rd October, 2025. currentContext.expansion: The Company's expansion during the year was in captive renewable power rather than foundry capacity. Its first ground-mounted solar power plant of 4500 kWp at Bamroli Village, Patan District is operating efficiently, and it has commissioned a second ground-mounted solar plant of the same 4500 kWp capacity for captive consumption at Balodhar Village, Patan District, which started working from August 2024; together the two plants contributed almost 40% of total power consumption. Under 'additional capital investment and proposals being implemented for reduction of consumption of energy', the Directors' Report states the two solar plants are working efficiently and that there is no further plan of the Company (the sentence is truncated in the routed text). On the foundry side no new plant, line or capacity addition is announced: production rose to 18,430 metric tons from 14,953 metric tons at the single manufacturing facility near Bavla, Ahmedabad, and management says that as tractor demand rises, customers are increasing production, leading to full utilisation of capacity. Ongoing spend is described only qualitatively as modernisation or replacement of machineries and use of high-end technology to improve machine efficiency and accuracy, replacement of inefficient motors with energy-efficient motors, LED and induction lighting, and optimisation of the operation of three furnaces. No technology has been imported in the past three years, and the Company has no subsidiary, joint venture or associate.
